objective: Jointly tune native-MTP reservation, hot capacity H, selected rows A, and batch size B without sacrificing logical context L=262144.

provenance.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080, compute capability 8.9, 15945 MiB VRAM

policy.mtp_rule: Reserve exact resolved native-MTP rows for full L before admitting hot pages; reject below that floor.
policy.a_rule: A is independently derived from validated attention geometry and is not silently increased to fill H.
policy.b_rule: B is benchmark-configurable and independent from the CUDA query tile.
policy.fallback_rule: No 77K or other reduced-context fallback is counted as 262K success.

ledger.scope: retained live B sweep at L=4096; values are measured references, not extrapolated 262K allocations
ledger.double_counting_control: KV storage tensor is excluded from fixed cost when represented by the pager plan; page storage is charged once by the plan.

search.choice_reason: Best measured prefill throughput and lower TTFT; B512 remains a decode-throughput alternative, so no unsupported universal winner is claimed.
search.a_h_nmax_sweep: deferred: existing calibrated A=2304, automatic H, and native MTP n_max=2 were retained; no fresh coherent multi-dimensional live sweep was possible while the active GPU service was spec-type none.

validation.build: cmake --build build --target test-cache-budget test-moe-cache-fit test-kv-pager test-kv-pager-model -j2
validation.live_262144_reason: Deferred: the resident server on port 8080 uses --spec-type none and the RTX 4080 has an unrelated active allocation; the historical PHASE23 262K record is explicitly not_run.
validation.allocation_claim: Local deterministic budget proof only; occupied full-context proof remains 26-01.
